Tech stocks led ASX higher following Wall Street surge; oil snapped a losing run on Saudi supply shock
Global oil near $100/bbl as Trump diesel export ban threatens to tighten supply; Australian fuel prices surging
RBA rate hikes continue to squeeze household spending; flash PMI sags signalling softening domestic demand

Jupiter Resources (JUP.AX) rare earths offtake progress via Critica product samples
Federal and state governments face mounting debt pressures; Albanese migration overhaul speech
Jetstar (QAN.AX) industrial action escalates with staff waiving baggage/seat fees
Chinese property recovery question and China's pivot to robotics impact commodity demand outlook
Property market cooling: rising listings, falling demand driving prices lower

sectors.trend: Miners rose on the ASX, supported by gold miners (Critical Resources, Aurum, Platina) and rare earths (Jupiter/Critica). Iron ore demand outlook mixed amid China property uncertainty and robotics pivot.
sectors.implications: Gold and rare earths sub-sectors offer relative strength. BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face headwinds if China property recovery stalls. JUP.AX offtake progress is a positive catalyst.

sectors.trend: Oil stocks struggled on the ASX despite global oil near $100. Saudi supply shock and Trump diesel ban create volatility. Australian fuel prices surging, pressuring consumer margins.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WLE.AX, XAR.AX face mixed signals: higher crude supports upstream but diesel cracks and fuel costs hurt downstream and consumer sentiment. Commonwealth funding of abandoned WA platform adds policy uncertainty.

sectors.trend: Tech stocks led ASX higher after Wall Street surge. Global AI capex (Nvidia, OpenAI, Anthropic, SpaceX) remains a dominant theme. $16B Aussie tech firm faces China-link controversy.
sectors.implications: ASX tech names benefit from global AI momentum but China exposure creates geopolitical risk. Data centre energy demand threatens net-zero targets, creating regulatory headwinds.

sectors.trend: RBA rate hikes squeezing household spending. Government debt cliff pressures sovereign credit. Property market cooling (rising listings, falling demand) threatens mortgage book quality.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face margin pressure from rate cycle peak and property softening. Higher rates support NIM but credit risk rises. Monitor NIM vs. provision trends.

sectors.trend: Fuel price surge and RBA tightening squeeze household budgets. Jetstar industrial action escalates. Qantas announces Sydney-New York non-stop. Property demand falling.
sectors.implications: QAN.AX faces operational disruption from Jetstar action. WES.AX, WTW.AX pressured by consumer spending weakness. Property REITs (GPG.AX, ICPL.AX) face falling demand and rising supply.

sectors.trend: Syngenis (SYG.AX) gains precision medicine venture firepower. Sector relatively insulated from commodity and rate cycles.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX remains defensive anchor. SYG.AX pipeline expansion is a positive catalyst. Sector offers relative stability amid macro uncertainty.

key_themes: Oil/fuel shock: Saudi supply disruption + Trump diesel ban driving global crude near $100, Australian pump prices surging
RBA tightening cycle: rate hikes squeezing household spending, flash PMI sags
Gold and rare earths: ASX small/mid-cap miners active (Critical Resources, Aurum, Platina, Jupiter)
China demand uncertainty: property recovery question, robotics pivot, impact on iron ore/coal
Government fiscal stress: federal and state debt cliff, Albanese migration overhaul
AI/tech capex boom: global valuations dwarfing 45 years of IPOs, data centre energy concerns
Property market cooling: rising listings, falling demand, price pressure on REITs and banks
Industrial action: Jetstar staff waiving fees, escalating labour tensions

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Oil/fuel price shock and inflationary pressure
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge fuel exposure; favour upstream energy (WDS.AX) over downstream; monitor RBA response to imported inflation

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA rate hikes and household spending contraction
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce consumer discretionary exposure; favour dividend-paying defensives (CSL.AX, WES.AX); monitor NAB/CBA provision guidance
Diversify away from pure iron ore/coal exposure; monitor China PMI and property data; favour gold and rare earths over base metals
Monitor sovereign credit ratings; favour ASX over government bonds; watch infrastructure and healthcare spending as offset
Avoid QAN.AX short-term; monitor Qantas competitive positioning; assess consumer travel demand impact
Reduce China-exposed ASX names; favour domestic revenue streams; monitor AUD/USD for risk-off moves

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold miners and rare earths on ASX
opportunities.rationale: Gold miners (Critical Resources, Aurum, Platina) showing momentum; Jupiter rare earths offtake progress; safe-haven demand amid oil shock and geopolitical risk

opportunities.recommendation: Favour upstream energy over downstream on oil shock
opportunities.rationale: Crude near $100 supports Woodside, Santos upstream; diesel cracks and fuel costs hurt downstream and consumer margins

opportunities.recommendation: Add defensive healthcare and consumer staples
opportunities.rationale: Syngenis pipeline expansion; CSL defensive; WES/WTW resilient through rate cycle and spending squeeze

opportunities.recommendation: Selective tech exposure on AI capex theme
opportunities.rationale: Global AI valuations surging; ASX tech led index higher; but manage China-link and data centre energy risks

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce consumer discretionary and property REIT exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: RBA tightening, falling property demand, rising listings, fuel cost squeeze on household budgets

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge fuel cost inflation via energy or short AUD
defensive_moves.rationale: Saudi shock and Trump diesel ban driving imported inflation; AUD likely under pressure

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid QAN.AX near-term; monitor Jetstar action escalation
defensive_moves.rationale: Industrial action disrupting operations and revenue; fee waivers signal deeper labour tensions

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim pure iron ore/coal exposure pending China data
defensive_moves.rationale: China property recovery uncertain; robotics pivot may reduce commodity intensity; ASX miners rose but sustainability questionable

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely range-bound to mildly negative. Oil shock and RBA tightening create headwinds, but tech strength and gold miners provide support. IDP.AX weakness and fuel cost inflation weigh on sentiment. Watch Trump-Xi meeting outcome for risk sentiment. Flash PMI softness suggests further RBA caution.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook cautious. Household spending under pressure from rates and fuel costs. Government debt trajectory concerning. However, gold, rare earths, and AI/tech capex provide structural growth pockets. China property recovery is the key swing factor for materials. Property market cooling may stabilise within 12 months.
key_catalysts: Trump-Xi meeting outcome and US-China trade/diesel policy
RBA next rate decision and CPI data post fuel shock
Global AI capex and data centre energy policy

Iron ore and gold prices (China demand)
ASX 200 sector rotation: tech vs. materials vs. energy
Chinese property sales and PMI data
Property listings and price index (SQM, CoreLogic)
